spans.s:
Cutting.
2

Loss, destruction.
3

Reaping.
4

Small, little; (according to some authorities, this when used attributively changes its gender, making लवः लवा लवं; according to others it is invariably masc.)
5 Smallness, littleness.
6 A minute division of time, the sixtieth part of the twinkling of an eye.
7 A larger division of time, two Kāṣṭhas or 36 twinklings of the eye, or about 1/2 a second.
8 One of the sons of

RĀMACANDRA.
9

A kind of quail.
10 Hair, wool, &c.; that which is cut or shorn from domestic animals.
11 (In arithmetic,) The numerator of a fraction.
n. (-वं)
1 The nutmeg.
2 Cloves.
E.
लु to cut, aff. अप्.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Cutting down.
mf. (-वः-वा)
A sort of quail, (Perdix chinensis.)
E.
लू to cut, to eat (corn,) causal form, aff. अच्; also with कन् added, लावक m. (-कः)

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Who or what cuts, reaps, cuts off, &c.
E.
लू to cut, ण्वुल् aff.

m. (-कः)
A sickle or reaping-hook.
E.
लू to cut, Uṇādi aff. आकन्.

m. (-ङ्गः)
The clove tree, (Myristica caryophyllata.)
n. (-ङ्गं)
Cloves, the fruit.
E.
लू to cut, Uṇādi aff. अङ्गच्; also with कन् added, लवङ्गक.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Salt, saline.
2 Handsome, beautiful.
n. (-णं)
1 Sea salt.
2 Rock or fossile salt.
3 Factitious salt, or salt obtained by boiling clay found near the sea-shore, or any earth impregnated with saline particles.
m. (-णः)
1 The saline or salt taste, saltness.
2 The sea of salt water.
3 The name of a Rākṣasa mentioned in the Rāmāyaṇa.
f. (-णा)
1 Light, lustre, beauty.
2 A small river in Tirhut.
E.
लू to cut, (rawness, or to assist digestion,) aff. ल्यु, and the final letter made nasal by special rule.

mfn. (-णः-णी-णं)
1 Salted, dressed or cooked with salt.
2 Salt, belonging or relating to it, &c.
E.
लवण salt, aff. अण्.

m. (-निः)
A salt mine in general, or the district of Sāmbher in Ajmere, celebrated for its fossile salt.
E.
लवण salt, and खानि a mine.

m. (-द्रः)
The sea of salt water.
E.
लवण, and समुद्र ocean.

m. (-रः)
A salt mine.
E.
लवण salt, and आकर a mine.

Nitre.
2

Rock or river salt.
E.
लवण salt, and उत्तम best.

m. (-दः)
The sea of salt water.
n. (-दं)
Brine.
E.
लवण salt, and उद water.

Reaping.
2

Cutting.
f. (-नी)
A coarse kind of custard apple, (Annona reticulata.)
E.
लू to cut, aff. ल्युट्.

f. (-ली)
A kind of creeper.

ind.
Piece meal, in pieces.
E.
लव a bit, and शसि aff.

n. (-कं)
A sickle, a reaping-hook.
E.
लू to cut, आणक Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-विः-विः-वि)
Cutting, edged, sharp, (as an instrument, &c.)
E.
लू to cut, Uṇādi aff. इन्.

n. (-त्रं)
A sickle, a small reaping-hook.
E.
लू to cut, aff. इत्रन्.

mfn. (-प्सुः-प्सुः-प्सु)
Wishing to cut or reap.
E.
लव, and ईप्सु desirous.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be cut.
E.
लू to cut, यत् aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be cut, to be cut off or drown.
E.
लू to cut, ण्यत् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Salted, cooked or dressed with salt.
2 Relating to salt, &c.
3 Lovely, beautiful.
m. (-कः)
A vender of salt, a salt merchant.
n. (-कं)
A vessel holding salt, a saltcellar.
E.
लवण salt, aff. ठक्.

n. (-ण्यं)
1 Saltness, the taste or property of salt.
2 Beauty, loveliness.
E.
लवण salt, and यञ् aff.

f. (-श्रीः)
Great beauty.
E.
लावण्य, and श्री wealth.

n. (-तं)
Property belonging to a woman, consisting of that which has been presented to her at her marriage as a token of respect, as a mark of kindness, or by her father or mother-in-law.
E.
लावण्य loveliness, and अर्जित acquired.

m. (-कः)
A buffalo.
E.
लव cutting, ठक् aff.

f. (-वुः-वूः)
A pumpkin gourd, (Cucurbita lagenaria.)
E.
लू to cut, to destroy, (disease,) aff. उण्; also with कन् added लावुका, and with अ or आङ् prefixed, अलावु, आलावु.
